title: PMP Limited - proposed merger with IPMG Group

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
ACCC requested further information from PMP and IPMG.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC received further information from PMP and IPMG.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed merger.

body_sections.Summary: PMP Limited, a publicly listed commercial printer, proposed to merge with IPMG Group, a print and digital services provider privately owned by members of the Hannan family.
body_sections.Market definition: Please refer to the Public Competition Assessment.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Please refer to the Public Competition Assessment.
